signal: EliseAI raised a $250M Series E led by a16z at a $2.2B valuation (Aug 2025), doubled its workforce, and crossed $100M ARR across 10% of the US apartment market.

email.body1:
Emily, saw EliseAI close that $250M Series E at a $2.2B valuation and double the team.

Scaling enablement that fast usually means more in-market accounts in play than reps can cover before the new hires ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for EliseAI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Emily, quick follow-up for EliseAI.

Post-raise, board expectations on pipeline jump faster than ramp can keep up, and most teams do not know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late. More reps alone rarely closes it in time.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings EliseAI needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add headcount.
email.body3:
Emily, last bit of proof for EliseAI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EliseAI's reply rate likely compares to other fast-scaling startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Emily, I will stop reaching out here, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not the priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the doubling-the-team stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to EliseAI either way.
